arabic text: JHULA TERA KHAALI HAI PARAYSHAAN HAI MAADAR\nMEI HAATHO KO PHELAATI HOON AAJA ALI ASGHAR
english translation text: YOUR CRADLE IS EMPTY, YOUR MOTHER IS DISTRESSED\nI STRETCH OUT MY HANDS; COME, ALI ASGHAR

arabic text: NAAZUK HAI GALAA TERA TU PYAASA BHI BOHOT HAI\nAA PAISH KARU TUJH KO MEI ASHQON KA SAMANDAR\nMEI HAATHO KO PHELAATI HOON AAJA ALI ASGHAR
english translation text: YOUR THROAT IS DELICATE, AND YOU ARE SO THIRSTY\nCOME, LET ME PRESENT TO YOU AN OCEAN OF MY TEARS\nI STRETCH OUT MY HANDS; COME, ALI ASGHAR

arabic text: AB RAAT HUI LAUT KE GHAR KYU NAHI AAYA\nJUNGLE HAI BIYABAAN HAI RONA NAHI DARKAR\nMEI HAATHO KO PHELAATI HOON AAJA ALI ASGHAR
english translation text: NOW NIGHT HAS FALLEN; WHY HAVE YOU NOT COME BACK HOME?\nTHE WILDERNESS IS DESOLATE; THERE IS NO NEED TO CRY\nI STRETCH OUT MY HANDS; COME, ALI ASGHAR

arabic text: MAQTAL MAI TO BARSAAT HAI TEERON KI MERI JAAN\nPAANI TUJHE TEERON SE PILAINGAY SITAMGAR\nMEI HAATHO KO PHELAATI HOON AAJA ALI ASGHAR
english translation text: IN THE BATTLEFIELD, MY LIFE, THERE IS A RAIN OF ARROWS\nTHE TYRANTS WILL GIVE YOU WATER THROUGH ARROWS\nI STRETCH OUT MY HANDS; COME, ALI ASGHAR

arabic text: MAQTAL KI HAWA KAISI KHABAR LA AAYI HAI BETA\nSUNTI HOON KE AIK TEER LAGA TERE GALAY PAR\nMEI HAATHO KO PHELAATI HOON AAJA ALI ASGHAR
english translation text: WHAT NEWS HAS THE WIND OF THE BATTLEFIELD BROUGHT, MY SON?\nI HEAR THAT AN ARROW HAS STRUCK YOUR THROAT\nI STRETCH OUT MY HANDS; COME, ALI ASGHAR

arabic text: MASOOM MUJAHID NE LARI JUNG JO REHAN\nHAATHIYAAR THA AIK TEER TABASSUM KA LABON PAR\nMEI HAATHO KO PHELAATI HOON AAJA ALI ASGHAR
english translation text: REHAN, WHEN THE INNOCENT WARRIOR FOUGHT HIS BATTLE\nHIS ONLY WEAPON WAS THE ARROW OF A SMILE UPON HIS LIPS\nI STRETCH OUT MY HANDS; COME, ALI ASGHAR
